integrity: All finite face enumerations, directed-cover acyclicity tests, signed Morse matrices and unit eliminations reproducible from embedded Python source.
scientific_limitations: Only three explicitly listed seven-column capacity vectors; homotopy certificates use complete finite integer Morse reductions. Symmetry modules and other board sizes are not classified. No independent mathematical validation.
title: Three torsion-free boundary chambers in seven-column multiple chessboard complexes
